mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_telemetry_minute ( aggregator_id, ent_id, project_id, device_id, device_code, point_code, data_time, minute_time, point_value, unit, quality, source_code, receive_time, raw_value ) VALUES ( #{aggregatorId}, #{entId}, #{projectId}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceCode}, #{pointCode}, #{dataTime}, #{minuteTime}, #{pointValue}, #{unit}, #{quality}, #{sourceCode}, #{receiveTime}, #{rawValue} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE aggregator_id = VALUES(aggregator_id), ent_id = VALUES(ent_id), project_id = VALUES(project_id), device_code = VALUES(device_code), data_time = VALUES(data_time), point_value = VALUES(point_value), unit = VALUES(unit), quality = VALUES(quality), source_code = VALUES(source_code), receive_time = VALUES(receive_time), raw_value = VALUES(raw_value)
